message:
## Vulnerability Digest

This primary product scan used only `Products.txt` and `List_of_SIA_Completed.txt`; obvious aliases, repeated rows, and versioned duplicates were consolidated. `DLL_software_component.txt` was not read or combined. The scan window was **2026-10-10 23:40 UTC through 2026-10-11 23:40 UTC** (**2026-10-11 05:10 IST through 2026-10-12 05:10 IST**).

No confirmed new vulnerability was found that both falls within the strict 24-hour window and maps directly to a product in the deduplicated primary inventory. Candidate records newly published on October 10 were timestamped before the cutoff or affected unlisted WordPress plugins and similarly adjacent packages rather than the named products.

### MongoDB ecosystem verification

The mandatory dedicated sweep covered MongoDB Server Community and Enterprise, `mongod`, `mongos`, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, `mongosh`, Database Tools, Kubernetes Operator, official drivers and connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm/App Services, and official MongoDB libraries and integrations.

No MongoDB-family vulnerability could be verified as newly reported in the scan window. MongoDB's latest authoritative alerts visible during the run were dated October 9 or earlier. Source: [MongoDB product alerts](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts).

### Triage note

An October 11 secondary report described CVE-2026-102255 affecting SonicWall SMA1000 appliances, including the monitored 8200V model, as actively exploited. It was excluded as a new finding because the [official SonicWall advisory](https://www.sonicwall.com/support/notices/kA1VN000002QP3G0AW) was published October 5, last updated October 6, and states that SonicWall has no evidence of exploitation; no authoritative in-window update confirming the secondary claim was found.

### Review priority

No immediate review is recommended based on newly reported, in-scope vulnerabilities during this window. Continue normal monitoring; this conclusion does not assess older vulnerabilities already associated with legacy product versions in the inventory.
